### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **6** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5d2ce34f88a0d3440386b381bd678a25cd59f7a4` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxk4f4T7at3YeFruhZ

**L1 verdict (L1-a): CHANGES** at head `5023ae8dbaa58bcdc9b05f26d6df3a561e82e845` (review requested through the seat). Code is unchanged from `400c82ee`, and the code review below covers both heads. The change itself is right and minimal. The one must-fix is how the PR describes its reach, because a public route still rejects without a reason.

**Gates:** `5023ae8d` has **no CI at all** at 02:57Z: 0 check-runs and 0 workflow runs for the head SHA, about 30 min after the push. The push did not trigger CI, so this is not yet a green head. The previous head `400c82ee`, with the same code, finished at 55 check-runs: 40 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed. `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` both passed there. The next push (fix (a)) should trigger CI; confirm it does before announcing.

**Must-fix:**
1. **"A rejection always carries its reason" is not true at merge, and the gap is not recorded.**
   - `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/reject` is the approvals route itself. It is a public SDK route (`rest-route-ledger.ts` ~475, disposition `sdk`, `client.approvals.reject(id, { comment? })`). It is unchanged and still records a reject with no comment. The body says so in one line (line 23) but gives no reason and no follow-up.
   - These texts state the guarantee without that limit:
     - the source comment on the param (`sys-approval-request.object.ts` ~701, "A rejection always carries its reason");
     - the docs sentence (`approvals.mdx` ~937, "A rejection carries its reason:");
     - the unit and dogfood test docblocks;
     - the two `approvals.json` checklist lines added in `5023ae8d`, which say "refused … at REST, MCP and the console". "At REST" should read "at the REST action door", because the REST approvals route still accepts a reject with no reason.
   - Fix both parts, the way #35680 / #35707 did:
     - (a) Scope the wording to the action, for example "A reject through `approval_reject` always carries its reason". The docs sentence's second half already names the three doors, so only its lead needs the scope.
     - (b) File the follow-up card for the route and SDK leg (whether `POST /approvals/requests/:id/reject`, `client.approvals.reject` and the service `decide` should refuse a reasonless reject too). That is a further narrowing with its own contract read. Name `#N` in the Acceptance notes so the seat's CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER read sees the cut.
   - Fixing (a) moves the head. If you would rather keep `Fixes #35659` without (b), say why the route is out of the maintainer's requirement; the card's acceptance names only the action.

**What I checked (holds):**
- **No new code path.** The only code change is `required: false` → `true` on `approval_reject.params.comment`, plus the AI description string.
  - `validateActionParams` (`spec/src/ui/action-params.zod.ts` ~131) counts `undefined`, `null`, `''` and whitespace-only as missing.
  - `enforceActionParams` (`runtime/src/action-execution.ts` ~3774) runs it, and is called once in the shared `action-dispatch.ts` (~622) that both the REST action door and MCP `run_action` use.
- **Ordering.** The MCP leg calls without the confirmation member and asserts `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`. That pins the param refusal before the confirmation gate, as the body says.
- **Tests are real pins with controls.**
  - Unit: `{}`, `''`, whitespace and `null` each give exactly `[['comment','required']]`. Controls: with a reason (with and without attachments) and `approval_approve`'s comment staying optional.
  - Dogfood: three bad bags at REST and MCP, then `expectUndecided`, then a CONTROL reject with a reason that writes the decision row `['reject','Over budget.']`.
  - The ablation in the body shows both going red on revert. The dogfood battery passed at `400c82ee` (4094 tests). The landing needs it re-pinned to the final head.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/plugin-approvals: patch` with a **BREAKING** paragraph and a caller fix. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none` and the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker fit a plugin-owned param declaration with no stored data. The `## Migration` line is present.
- **Surface extensions.** The dogfood file is the only harness that reaches both doors. The two `approvals.json` lines (`5023ae8d`, at the seat's request) correct the "optional Comment" text and keep approve's comment optional. Both are declared in the body, and I accept them.

**Notes (non-blocking):**
1. The MCP leg never sends a call with no `comment` key: `act()` always sends `params: { comment }`, so `{}` goes out as `''`. Missing-key is covered by the unit pin and the REST leg through the same dispatch, so this is low risk.
2. The refusal sentence is the existing English param-contract message, as the order asked. Localizing it belongs to the param contract, not this card.

Next: fix (a) and record (b), push, and announce the final green head. I do a delta review; then the seat runs the CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER read and a4-W lands it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f350577622b2227b8aee2684a5395fc827ca6ed1`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts (+ its test), packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts, content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx, docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json, .changeset/35659-approval-reject-requires-reason.md
Security-touching: no

Read: card #35659 (body and its comments), #35593 (body, item 6 and its acceptance line), #35719 (body), PR #35716 (title, body, the net diff of its 6 files against `main`, +94/-5), L1 records 7028928770 and 7030081619, os-dev report 7030048961, the check-runs on this head, AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3, and on `main`: `packages/spec/src/ui/action-params.zod.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxApprovalItem.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx`, the auto-reject paths of `approval-service.ts`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **What is newly refused is exactly a reasonless reject through `approval_reject`.** The only behaviour change is `required: false` → `true` on that action's `comment` param. `isActionParamValuePresent` counts `undefined`, `null`, `''` and a whitespace-only string as missing, so those four are the refused set; a reject with a reason, with or without attachments, runs as before. A reject carrying attachments but no comment is refused too, which is the requirement (a reason, not a file). `approval_approve` and the other seven declared actions are untouched; the unit pin holds approve's comment optional.
- **System rejections are unaffected.** The revision-limit auto-reject (`approval-service.ts`, writes its own `Auto-rejected: revision limit (N) exceeded` comment) and the SLA `auto_reject` escalation run inside the service and never pass the action dispatch. The approvals route `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/reject` and `client.approvals.reject` are unchanged, as the body, the changeset and the source comment each say.
- **Refusal shape is the existing one and the same at both server doors.** REST action door and MCP `run_action` share one dispatch, so both answer `400`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, message naming `comment`; the dogfood pin asserts all three at both doors and that the request stays undecided. The console holds Confirm with the translated `actionDialog.requiredError`. No new sentence, no new code.
- **Other callers in the repo.** No source outside plugin-approvals runs `approval_reject` without a reason: `approval-act-doors-read-visibility` already sends `{ comment: 'no' }`; HotCRM names the action only to forbid it in a skill.
- **Docs and checklist are true at this head.** `approvals.mdx` scopes its sentence to `approval_reject` and names the three doors. Both edited `approvals.json` lines say "at the REST action door"; the approve step's "optional Comment" stays true. No other text under `content/docs/automation`, `content/docs/ai`, `skills/` or the checklist says a reject's comment is optional.
- **Check-runs on the head:** 59, all completed: 42 `success`, 17 `skipped`, none failed or pending. Mergeable state `clean`; the PR is draft.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/plugin-approvals` at `patch` with the BREAKING banner: accepted. AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3 sets the level by the `Metadata-protocol` kind alone, and "a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition". `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: the kind measures what a metadata author can write, and no author writes this declaration (it is the plugin's own object metadata; no spec key, accepted value or requirement on authored metadata moves). That is the difference from the #33121 ruling, where the platform began refusing something an author could write, hence `narrowed` and `minor`. Here what is refused is a runtime request to one action, so `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is the arm that carries it. The changeset has both declaration lines, one ADR-0087 marker (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, fitting: no stored row or authored value to rewrite), and the caller's one-line fix. The PR body has `## Migration`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`Fixes #35659` is justified.** The card's 要做的 and 验收 name only `approval_reject` at REST, MCP and the console; it does not ask for the approvals route or the SDK method. That leg is #35719 (open) and the email link is #35722, both named in the body before merge.
- **The inbox is already covered by this PR, not left to #35719.** See S2.

### ④ Findings

- **S1 · The PR title claims more than the diff does.** "rejecting an approval requires a reason at every door" is the platform-wide claim L1 had removed from the body, docs, changeset and comments; the approvals route still records a reject with no reason until #35719. The title becomes the landed commit subject. Retitle to the changeset's own line, "rejecting through the `approval_reject` action requires a reason", before arming. A title edit does not move the head, so this record stands.
- **S2 · The body misplaces the inbox.** It says #35719 covers "the inbox", which "still accept[s] a reject with no reason". The inbox panel (`InboxApprovalItem.tsx`) and the approvals list draw Reject as the declared `approval_reject` at `list_item` through `DeclaredActionsBar`, so they open the same param dialog and, from this PR on, hold Confirm until a reason is typed. That is a user-visible change this PR makes (the checklist line it replaced said the declaration "keeps it optional for the approvals list"). The 维护者速读 line and the Acceptance note should say the inbox and approvals list now require the reason too, and #35719 should be left with the route, the SDK method and service `decide`. Body edit only.
- **N1 ·** The body's CI line reads "40 success, 15 skipped"; the head now shows 42 and 17.
- **N2 ·** `approvals.mdx` puts "(`400`, …)" after a list that includes the dialog; the dialog refuses client-side and answers no status. Wording only.
- **N3 ·** The MCP leg of the dogfood pin never sends a call with no `comment` key (L1 note 1); the REST leg and the unit pin cover the missing key through the same dispatch.

Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4d1PJ4isQ3eD7Fk1fnF`

**VERDICT: PASS**
